subject: economics
title: Elasticity and Surplus
welcome_lead: Measure responsiveness with elasticities - measure welfare with surplus.
meta_desc: A-Level Microeconomics: PED, PES, YED, XED and consumer/producer surplus.
final_note: Elasticities turn vague language into precise numbers.

concepts.def: Price elasticity of demand = percent change Q / percent change P.
Area between price and demand curve.
Area between price and supply curve.

walkthroughs.body_html: An absolute PED below 1 is inelastic, above 1 elastic. YED above 1 marks luxuries, below 0 inferior goods. XED positive means substitutes, negative means complements.
Consumer surplus is the triangle between the demand curve and the price line. Producer surplus is the triangle between the price line and the supply curve.
Taxes, monopolies and price ceilings create deadweight loss - surplus lost to neither party. Welfare analysis lives or dies by surplus measurement.
